summary: Resolved two critical pipeline issues: (1) Eliminated steer and prompt duplication when moving cards between columns or auto-running agents by removing description injection in boardStore.ts, adding backend equivalence guard (prompt == task.description => None), and implementing store-level and SQLite-level deduplication across last 3 items for steer messages; (2) Removed artificial step limit 'sub_turn > 15' in run_inprocess_subagent, implemented autonomous synthesis turn (tools: None) when tool execution ends without text, stored subagent reports in SubagentRetryInfo, implemented 3-tier subagent collection in collect_subagent (channels -> sessions -> SQLite DB), and persisted subagent todo_write execution into SQLite dialog items.
